content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inability to handle single-choice parameters correctly when exporting HQL reports to CSV. Specifically, the code did not check if the parameter value was null before attempting to process it, leading to potential null pointer exceptions or incorrect handling of the parameter values. The fix introduced a null check for the parameter value, ensuring that the export process could handle cases where a single-choice parameter was not provided, thus restoring the functionality that was broken by a previous commit.
